title: Surface loadings and solids concentration

cell_spans.description: Printed group heading 'Separate Sludge' fills the full width; its loading and concentration cells are printed blank.
Printed group heading 'Combined Sludge' fills the full width; its loading and concentration cells are printed blank.

markdown:
| Type of Sludge | Solids Surface Loading (kg/day/sqm) | Thickened Sludge Solids Concentration (%) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Separate Sludge |  |  |
| Primary | 90 - 140 | 5 – 10 |
| Activated | 25 - 30 | 2.5 - 3.0 |
| Trickling filter | 40 - 45 | 7 – 9 |
| Combined Sludge |  |  |
| Primary + activated | 30 - 50 | 5 – 8 |
| Primary + trickling filter | 50 - 60 | 7 – 9 |
notes: Prints the range separator inconsistently: the loading column uses a space-hyphen-space form ('90 - 140') while the concentration column uses a space en-dash-space form in '5 – 10' and '7 – 9' but a hyphen in '2.5 - 3.0'. All separators kept exactly as printed; not harmonised.
Area unit printed as 'sqm' in the header, not m².
'Separate Sludge' and 'Combined Sludge' are group headings, not sludge types with values; the two value cells beside each are printed empty and are not filled in.
No source line or footnote is printed with this table.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 288-450 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed table is set sideways; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed and no verification seal.
